title: Hello, World!
description: Write your first program and learn the basics of JavaScript — from printing a message to creating functions that greet multiple people.

steps.title: Print a greeting
steps.description: Use `console.log()` to print the string `"Hello, World!"` to the console.
hints: console.log() prints whatever you put inside the parentheses

verification.successMessage: Great! You printed your first message!
verification.failureMessage: Make sure you print 'Hello, World!' exactly.

steps.title: Use a variable
steps.description: Store the greeting string in a variable named `greeting`, then print the variable.
hints: Pass the variable name to console.log(), not the string directly

verification.successMessage: You used a variable! Variables let you store and reuse values.
verification.failureMessage: Make sure you assign 'Hello, World!' to the greeting variable.

steps.title: Create a function
steps.description: Write a function named `greet` that returns the string `"Hello, World!"`. Then call it with `console.log()`.
hints: Use the `return` keyword to send the string back
Call the function with greet() inside console.log()

verification.successMessage: Functions let you package code for reuse!

steps.title: Add a parameter
steps.description: Modify the `greet` function to accept a `name` parameter and return `"Hello, [name]!"`.
hints: Add a parameter inside the parentheses: greet(name)
Use string concatenation or template literals: "Hello, " + name or `Hello, ${name}!`
Template literals use backticks and ${} syntax

steps.title: Greet multiple people
steps.description: Use the `greet` function with an array of names. Loop through the array and greet each person.
hints: Use a for loop or forEach to iterate over the array
Call greet() for each name and print the result

verification.test: output.includes('Hello, Alice!') && output.includes('Hello, Bob!') && output.includes('Hello, Charlie!')
verification.successMessage: You combined functions, arrays, and loops!
verification.failureMessage: Make sure you greet all three people in the array.
